title: MILO Marathon 2026 Vermosa Leg Review: A Wellness Township Debut
seo_title: MILO Marathon Vermosa Leg 2026 Review | Cavite, PH
meta_description: MILO Marathon 2026 Vermosa Leg review: October 11 at Ayala's active-living township in Cavite -- part of the 50th-anniversary Golden Run series.
dek: Set for 11 October 2026 at Vermosa, a 770-hectare wellness-focused township straddling Imus and Dasmariñas, this leg brings the MILO Marathon's Golden Run series to the Philippines' first dedicated active-living community.
verdict: The Vermosa leg gives the MILO Marathon's 50th-anniversary Golden Run series a genuinely purpose-built venue: Vermosa is a 770-hectare Ayala Land township in Cavite, established in 2015 as the Philippines' first development explicitly built around active lifestyles and wellness, anchored by the Ayala Vermosa Sports Hub (opened 2018). That's a meaningfully different setting than most MILO legs, which typically use city plazas or malls not specifically designed for athletic events. Five distances from 1K to 21K keep it accessible. Registration status wasn't yet confirmed open at the time of this research.

sections.heading: One of 15 Legs, at a Purpose-Built Sports Venue
paragraphs: The Vermosa leg offers 1K, 3K, 5K, 10K and 21.1K distances, part of the MILO Marathon's 50th-anniversary 'Golden Run' series -- 15 regional legs nationwide ahead of the National Finals in Clark City, Pampanga. [1] Unlike most legs in this series, which run through city streets or mall-adjacent plazas, Vermosa is a venue explicitly designed with athletic activity in mind.

sections.heading: The Philippines' First Active-Living Township
paragraphs: Vermosa is a 770-hectare mixed-use estate established by Ayala Land in 2015, straddling the cities of Imus and Dasmariñas in Cavite -- the first development of its kind in the Philippines built specifically to highlight active lifestyles and wellness. [2] Its centrepiece, the Ayala Vermosa Sports Hub, opened to the public in March 2018 and combines residential, retail, office and institutional spaces with dedicated sports and fitness amenities.

sections.heading: A Genuine Fit for a Running Event
paragraphs: That wellness-focused design makes Vermosa a genuinely fitting host for a marathon leg, in contrast to venues repurposed from commercial or civic use. Purpose-built sports infrastructure typically means better road surfaces, clearer course marking, and amenities (medical stations, cooling zones) designed with athletic events specifically in mind.

sections.heading: Registration Not Yet Confirmed
paragraphs: As of this writing, registration status for the Vermosa leg has not been confirmed open. [1] Given the venue's growing profile as an active-lifestyle destination, demand could be notable once registration opens -- worth checking the official MILO site directly for updates.

sections.heading: Should You Run It?
paragraphs: If a MILO Marathon leg at a venue specifically built for athletic and wellness activities appeals -- rather than a repurposed city plaza -- the Vermosa leg on 11 October 2026 is a genuinely fitting choice within the 50th-anniversary Golden Run series. Confirm registration status with organisers before booking travel.
